definition: Maize-derived feed material consisting primarily of bran separated during milling; it has by-product role and may include variable attached endosperm.
rationale: States approved source component process and product-role semantics without treating bran as one anatomical structure.

definition: A material fraction separated from cereal grain during milling and consisting mainly of outer grain layers with variable attached endosperm.
rationale: Defines Bran as material component rather than one anatomical plant part.
